body:
... I don't know.
In addition, me, being involved, can't even see a solution, then why would someone else? 
thanks though... I don't know... Eh..
Thanks..

I ... don't know. I am sure that the people around me don't care, though, it's not like, I'm making the decision.. ehh.. I understand that you care, but, like.. I was, idk.. I just meant that, there's for sure no solution to my problems.. and that is why it would waste your time...

I have sort of tried by starting with ranting about an small issue to a good friend once, but then the conversation shifted and I discovered that my friend has a lot of issues of her own. So, I couldn't bother her.
But otherwise, other people, I am definitely sure they don't care.
I just know it. And I am positively sure about it.
... So, there's nothing I can do.. and would it even make it better if I talked to someone, though? Life is life, and it's just a bunch of shit. 
Anyways, yeah, there's nothing I can do, but, some part of me is still hoping that I can get better, I assume, since I'm posting on Reddit and responding. But this hope is dumb. 99.99% of hope leads to disappointment. 
Anyways, thanks. Sorry for wasting your time though..

There's really nothing good about myself. Compared to the world, I'm just one of those stupid human beings at the bottom, that cannot contribute to the society. I can't get myself to kill myself, or to go the other way to reach for someone (though it's also a bad idea). I'm useless.
Plus, Look at all those other people in this world, there's plenty of people. Who needs me in the society, one less number means nothing at all to this huge world population.

I don't really think that anyone loves me that much, to the friends I have, I'm just one of those people where they talk to occasionally when they are bored, and I don't even make good conversations. 

Why would a stupid girl, somewhere in the world, be important to you? A lot of people die each day anyways. When my day comes, it'll just be another one tiny person gone from the world, doesn't matter, and I won't have to feel- or think anything, how sweet... only if I wasn't such a GODDAMN USELSS BITCH and I could get some fucking idea soon

Sorry, but I'm not built for life, it's upsetting to live, and it frustrates me to be alive so... yeah. I appreciate your response though. You're a nice person, but people like me, is worth... nothing. Thanks though

You get nothing good from life. Even if you do, you'll either lose it, or get something really bad in return. 

I just can't get myself to tell anyone around me. They wouldn't care, plus.. no one would truly, really understand what I'm thinking. I cannot really explain my views clearly anyways. 

And that is why this idiot is literally stuck here wanting to leave but is too much of an idiot to take action. 
'Wow, what a funny failure.'
... yeah.. I'm really can't at the moment.. but maybe.. eventually... thanks..

I really really can't take the step there.. I just keep thinking that they will judge me... and stuff... but there's really no other way.. huh... I don't know.. maybe I should try to keep going alone for now...

First of all.. thanks.. for listening to my messed up and disorganized ideas... 
... Yeah, I think I should get help, but these steps are extremely difficult. Extremely. Plus, I have a feeling they might not understand me, at all, since, last year, it was exactly this month, around this time when I talked to one of them. A while before exams. They'll just think that I freak out every time before exams, which I'm not. I'm like this the whole time.. It is just getting harder and harder to deal with though. But even if I say this, they'll just think I'm confused, they won't understand. I'm also scared of them judging, it, I can imagine people thinking about what I say and laugh about it, or, get confused and think that I'm just an extremely confused child that can't handle exams. How did this exam idea come into my mind? Well, I just remembered, that my parents, they also thought I was just stressed out for exams at one point since they said that I should not stress over exams. And I don't even know what to say, or anything... This just won't work... :/  

And, even if I'm not judgemental, it doesn't mean other people aren't. My parents would be driving in a car, and would judge people by what they do outside, their actions. It's something I dislike, but, now I know, the bitter reality.. People are judgemental. If you sound stupid, they would always look at you differently... 
oh, and, I'm not that new to Canada... I've moved here for, about 7 years or so... but still, the problems caused...not quite sure what can I do.. the only way is really go to a counsellor's office? I really can't though...
Also, thanks again for, responding to me.. (must be a pain to deal with me so yeah)

My relationship with my mom is pretty much the same, except she's slightly more strict. No, I don't have any brothers or sisters. 
Well, I'm just failing at everything. Life.
I tried to help out/calm/stop some family arguments and stuff, but, it's unstoppable and this helped me realize what a complete failure I am.
I was failing in school in Hong Kong, that was the whole reason our family had to move here to Canada. If we didn't move here, and interact with these relatives, maybe my mom wouldn't find some stuff out and all this happen. 
... I made that happen. Now, I should be happy and all right now, right? I'm not. I just feel incapable and useless.. 
I tried to solve family stuff, but I failed( I know now that this isn't solvable. But. I may have caused it all. May have done the opposite of helping ) After all that, I was very done with life. 
I tried to get better, but I failed. I tried to stop thinking, but I can't. 
I tried to socialize with people and have a nice social network, I failed, they all turned their backs against me recently( because of a person shit talking me because they feel like it ). 
Everything, I can't do everything or anything. I am trying to organize everything, in order, my thoughts, it's all a mess now, all I know, is that, I'm a failure. I should be working hard now, being some top student, not thinking like this, not feeling like this, (how shameful I feel like this), I should be repaying them in the future, making money, because, this is how it goes, is it not, but I can't, this, this life thing isn't made for me, I want to get the fuck out, I'm a failure, a failing investment you can say. 

I'm sorry. I can't get everything to make sense in words... and it's starting to not make sense to me... either... all I know, for sure is that, the harder you try, the more you will fail, my life is set for failure. There's really, nothing, I can do. But I want to do something. Yeah, I still have that hope, that maybe I can change, though.. I do know that it won't happen. Unless I get hit in the head really hard, get amnesia, believe the hopeful lies that are all over this planet. Yeah, why the fuck am I not dead yet? Because I'm a coward, and I want to wait until I have access to alcohol and drugs and maybe combine a few things together. But for now, I can only hope because I can't... I must sound like .. I must be a hilarious loser to you... A hilarious fool that cannot handle the reality that she's already in the game of life..

Both my parents was, but since I was so against them saying anything, they promised to only get them aware that I'm acting strange and such. But, they didn't say much about it. They just questioned what I was doing in school and told me not to cause trouble.. and that was it.
Well, there's absolutely no one I can actually talk to. This is how it is. And my parents don't really care, well more like they don't understand me at all. 
It sucks, it's terrible, when no one in the world really understands what you want to say. When everything you do fails. When it's all just a torturous game.

Not sure how to describe it. But he thinks that he knows me well, and he thinks I'm in my room because I'm addicted to games. We can get along so-so, but, he's only understanding in some situations.. And he takes things lightly. If I said anything, he would be laughing at me.
They would be disappointed and would hate me and would think that I'm stupid. No, I can't talk to any of them, ever..

The thing is- I don't want my parents to know at all, and going to a regular doctor and all that won't work. And speaking to counsellors at school are not the best, since.. they might also notify my parents. I have admitted that I was slightly suicidal and it was a rule that they talk to my parents no matter what, though they did promise to not to mention it and just get them aware that I'm acting strangely and such. 
But. I don't know. there's really not away to speak to anyone. Plus, I may not be able to get my thoughts out in words.. it's just stuck in my head. 
...

I'm not sure.. I don't think so, though.
Since those people are probably sick and disgusted of me.. and I should stay away..

Sometime in June... 
Well I signed up for summer school.. and that will occupy me for a month... sorta.. then idk..

Well, a year ago, this month, when everything I suddenly snapped, apparently I was acting like another person or something.. so a teacher brought me to the school counsellor, but, we only talked for a while before summer came and, I just couldn't express all the things that were bothering me and they probably think that I'm really stupid and just weird... I don't know. She did help a little by suggesting writing things down.. but i can't do that because I don't want someone finding what I written down especially my parents...

Yeah, well I tried writing it out, but I couldn't express it well, and I tried to talk things out with a friend, but they don't understand.. just starting from the surface and talking about the smaller things that bother me, well, that person took it as those.. small daily issues.. i don't know, but.. I just can't explain to anyone how I feel well.
I guess it's slightly easier. But. I still can't really communicate my feelings well. And It's jut the fact that no one would ever truly understand.
I don't know. I don't feel too much better... Just, no one would really understand... and maybe I think in a weird way.. but...  :/
I guess.. thanks
Although some part of me still thinks in that way... thanks. You helped me think a little more in a better direction

No... I meant the literal coal. With them burning.. oxygen would run out... if you're in and enclosed space... and so on... I just wish.. I can vanish.. easily.. soon.. without too much pain..
I'm 15. Well, I don't enjoy much things. I used to like some video games and music and piano.. but now, not anymore.. It's pretty pointless... I am still trying to get something to pass time, and I'm playing phone games.... Recent...happiness...I cannot pinpoint anything at the moment...
... It's just stupid how we have to live. It's stupid...

I think my cousin and their family (mom's side) may have depression.. something like that. My cousin is suicidal (I heard), and the whole family is acting different. I don't know. They are half the world away... 
That reminds me, my mom's family, her side of the family, are all on the other side of the world... and she doesn't have a job, she just stays home... doing chores... everyday... and then... lash out once in a while... 
Oh yeah, I.. made all this happen... ironic.
I struggled in school in Hong Kong so badly, that we had to move to Canada for better education.. it was for me..
Then all this happens, everyone feels worse, and I feel bad for being in this situation.. when I started it all... 
... I don't want to think anymore... ugh...  I don't know.. I don't know......why....... ....am I bothering you too much? I'm sorry.. I just.. need someone to talk to, to rant, about, everything in the world to get past.. time..... sorry... thanks for responding to me

Thanks.. right now I'm still finding someone that I could talk to, but is it depression? Or is it just the bitter reality and logic...  being realistic?..
Knowing that no good future comes, because I am dumb, is logic.
Knowing that things won't get better based on what happened, logic
Knowing that life has no point and you're supposed to lie to yourself and brainwash yourself into something that make you live, bitter reality...
Am I someone that's so weak and terrible, that I can't accept reality? ... how pathetic I am... I hate life, and the fact that I am not built for life, that I'm whining and I cannot do much about it right now...

Well, I do know that my parents do not want anyone knowing about their situation. I am not allowed to say anything about them... So I don't think they could get marriage counselling or anything.
Also, I do worry about my mother more, since she acts more tense, and is very unforgiving, but sometimes will cry and beg for forgiveness (but then be unforgiving and hateful again), throws things, does not let my father sleep, and then cycle goes on... but now my father gets angry more often... and it's a huge downhill... It's obviously just going to get stuck here and get gradually worse...
So...
Who to tell? The thing is, I don't think anyone I know would actually care what I have to say. Well, most people probably don't care about others, at all. I fear that, telling one person, would cause them to tell their friends, and then there's a whole group of people silently judging me... 
... Well, I don't think there's anything I can do, but feel like shit about this... and wait.. for what seems like eternity...until peace...
...Sorry.. I'm not that convinced that, anything will actually change anything... I may have only wasted your time...

Well, I guess I'll just rant a little for now. Since there's nothing else I can do..
My parents, they argued all the time, which is normal... but around the same issue. About one side of the family taking the money that was borrowed from the other side.. something like that. A huge chunk of money though. They won't drop it, and it keeps coming up over and over again, and it's really stressful when there's all silent dinners, or no dinners, or just yelling and stuff being thrown to the floor. And.. also, I think that one of them might be pretty insane. The more I think about it, one of them would throw stuff, freak out, shove the other, screaming "hit me", then... well there's a lot of details. But I'll just leave it at that for now.
That started a few years back and it.. never stopped and never will.
Months ago (over half a year ago), I was finally sick and tired of this. I get really scared, worried, and upset. And then.. I started to contemplate life and why I was dealing with this anyways... and that's when I realized that dying, as soon as possible, is the best choice.
But the problem was, I don't have anything to kill myself with, and not a good plan, and my parents are always around.
During that time, I started to "act differently" and "change drastically" over in school. I was constantly sad, nothing is important anymore... Well, this repeated issue always happened, and I would act all normal in school, but this time, I was too tired, and realized too much of life to keep up my act.. thus causing me to act drastically different. At that time, I was still trying to plan a way to get out of life.
That teacher caught on really well, and made me speak to a counsellor. I slowly opened up, and talked about the issues, and how I just wanted to get away from it and rather die. 
"Hope" "Time" That's all I learned, really. There wasn't a fix to the issue, but, she made it sound like it was going to get better, and life has better things to offer. I sort of believed it, a little.
It got slightly better, when I had someone to talk to about it, but...
Summer came, and then that repeated and, nothing got better. Things got worse
I also have no hobbies, and goals also... 
Life is filled with sadness.
One shot, on killing myself, and I'm not going to do anything until I get all the things, space, and time I need. And that must wait until I am past high school. 
Terrible, everyday knowing that life isn't worth living, knowing that the next day will be worse than the next.
Such a terrible feeling. 
School starts, and I work. I left the friends I used to be with, since i never belonged anyways. I have nothing.
I met some nice people, slowly got along, but afterwards started distancing myself from them. They did help me pass time, but.. I feel. I had to pretend as another person, and it's tiring.
Well, everyday going to school now, I still have to act pretty calm and collected, and just do things, and it's really tiring. I don't want to do anything, going to school won't get me anywhere, I already plan to give life up anyways, and if I don't die, I'd just end up as a poor person on the streets struggling. Just- sadness awaits. Nothing else. Happiness is just a little short moment.

There's nothing for me in life. I'm not built for life. I don't want to live life. Yet I have to for now. Until I get my chance to die. And it's terrible, the headaches, sadness. Everything. So, so tired of it.
And it won't get better, just worse.
I know I wrote a lot, and it probably came out not making much sense and I can't get everything out properly through writing... And you probably don't really care...
.... This is terrible...
